board_authority: Board of Secondary Education, Andhra Pradesh (BSEAP)
ownership: Government (also followed by many private/aided schools)
exam_window: March (results typically by June)
passing_criteria: Pass mark 35/100 per subject (20/100 for the second language paper); grading is Grade-Point based (A1 highest down to E fail), with a minimum GPA of 3.0 (Grade D2) required to pass
next_step: Choose one: Intermediate (MPC/BiPC/CEC/MEC/HEC) via bieap.apcfss.in, AP POLYCET for a diploma, ITI for a trade certificate, or NIOS if unable to continue formal school
approx_fee: Free / nominal in government schools; govt-aided schools may charge small fees
source: shiksha.com/boards/bseap-board; jnanabhumiap.in

board_authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
ownership: Private (a smaller number are Central Govt schools like KVs/JNVs)
medium_of_instruction: English (most common); some Hindi/Telugu medium sections
exam_window: February-March (results typically by May)
passing_criteria: Pass mark 33% per subject
next_step: Same downstream choices as SSC students: Intermediate/Junior College (can continue CBSE Class 11-12 or move to AP Intermediate board), POLYCET diploma, or ITI
approx_fee: Varies widely by school (typically Rs 20,000 - Rs 2,00,000+/year) - unverified, needs school-by-school follow-up
source: AP Intermediate admission eligibility notes (brinto.in)

board_authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
classes_covered: Classes 1-10 (10 is the board-exam year, called ICSE)
exam_window: February-March
passing_criteria: Minimum ~33-35 marks out of 100 per subject to pass (theory + internal/practical)
next_step: Same downstream options as CBSE/SSC students; ICSE is explicitly recognised as an equivalent qualifying board for AP Intermediate admission
approx_fee: Typically among the higher-fee private school options - exact figures vary per school, unverified
source: collegedekho.com ICSE passing marks guide; brinto.in AP Intermediate admission guide

board_authority: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Ministry of Education, Govt of India - CBSE affiliated
ownership: Government (Central Govt, fully residential and free)
classes_covered: Classes 6-12 (main entry at Class 6; limited lateral entry at Class 9)
medium_of_instruction: Three-language formula: English, Hindi, and Telugu, shifting toward English/Hindi in later classes
exam_window: Timeline has shifted earlier: for the 2027-28 admission cycle, the application form was released 6 Jul 2026 with the deadline extended to 10 Aug 2026 (correction window closed 12 Aug 2026), and the entrance exam itself is now scheduled 28 Nov 2026 - earlier than the older 'mid-January' pattern this row previously described. That window is already closed as of this data pull (Sept 2026); the next (2028-29) cycle's notification is not yet out
passing_criteria: Selection-test merit rank; 75% seats reserved for rural-area students, 33% for girls, plus SC/ST/EWS/PwD reservations
next_step: Continues within the same JNV to Class 11-12, then the same downstream entrance exams as other CBSE students (AP EAPCET, NEET, etc.)
approx_fee: Free (tuition, boarding, food, uniforms, books all provided at no cost)
source: school.careers360.com / education.sakshi.com JNVST 2027-28 application-form articles; en.wikipedia.org Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (verified Sept 2026)

board_authority: Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, Govt of India - CBSE affiliated
ownership: Government (Central Govt, residential; boys and girls)
medium_of_instruction: English (CBSE English-medium), with NCC/military-style training alongside academics
key_exam: AISSEE (All India Sainik Schools Entrance Examination)
exam_window: Confirmed recurring pattern: for the AISSEE 2027 cycle, NTA is expected to open registration around Oct-Nov 2026 with the exam tentatively 17 Jan 2027 (results ~Feb 2027, counselling Mar-Jun 2027) - not yet open as of this data pull (Sept 2026)
passing_criteria: Age criteria per entry class; merit in AISSEE + medical fitness; girls admitted against ~10% reserved quota
next_step: Continues within Sainik School to Class 11-12 (Science stream common), preparing directly for the NDA/NA entrance exam after Class 12
approx_fee: Reported figures vary by source and are not from Sainik School Korukonda's own official page: aggregator fee-structure trackers cite an annual tuition around Rs 1.28 lakh (with ~10% yearly increase) plus one-time/annual extras (caution money ~Rs 3,000, clothing ~Rs 27,000, diet ~Rs 34,000/year); other sources have cited figures closer to Rs 1.9 lakh/year all-in. Treat as approximate until confirmed on the school's own site - fees vary by category (SC/ST/OBC concessions apply)
source: school.careers360.com AISSEE 2027 tracker; ezyschooling.com / aissee.live Sainik School fee-structure pages (verified Sept 2026 - fee figures conflict between aggregators, flagged unverified)

school_type: Rashtriya Military School (RMS) - none located in AP
board_authority: Rashtriya Military Schools Society, Ministry of Defence, Govt of India - CBSE affiliated
exam_window: Cycle broadly similar to other Central Govt defence-school CETs - exact 2026 AP-relevant dates not independently verified
passing_criteria: Age criteria per entry class; boys only; open to defence-personnel and civilian applicants
next_step: No RMS is physically located in Andhra Pradesh (5 RMS confirmed at Ajmer & Dholpur (Rajasthan), Belgaum & Bangalore (Karnataka), and Chail (Himachal Pradesh)); leads to Class 11-12 Science and NDA/NA preparation, same as Sainik Schools
approx_fee: Central Govt subsidised fees (lower than most CBSE private schools) - exact current figure not verified
source: sainikcoaching.web.app Rashtriya Military Schools locations & admission guide; rashtriyamilitaryschools.edu.in official prospectus (verified Sept 2026 - 5-school locations confirmed unchanged, none in AP)

school_type: AP Gurukulam Residential Schools (APSWREIS / APTWREIS / APMJPBCWREIS / APREIS)
board_authority: Respective AP Welfare Societies - Social/Tribal/BC Welfare / General Residential Educational Institutions Societies, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
ownership: Government (State Govt, residential, largely free for eligible community students)
classes_covered: Classes 5-12 (main entry at Class 5 via joint APGPCET; lateral entry at Classes 6-9 via society-specific CETs)
key_exam: APGPCET (joint 5th-class entrance test) or society-specific tests: APSWRS CET (SC), APTWRS CET (ST), APBCWRS CET (BC), APRS CET (general/open)
exam_window: Confirmed via the 2026 cycle: notification last week of Jan 2026, online applications through 31 Mar 2026, entrance exam 24 Apr 2026 - so the window runs Jan-Apr rather than Feb-Apr. Covers 185 Balayogi (SW) + 31 Tribal Welfare + 61 MJP BC Welfare residential schools (277 schools total). That cycle is closed; 2027 cycle notification not yet out as of this data pull (Sept 2026)
passing_criteria: Community-specific eligibility (SC/ST/BC/general); admission by merit rank in the relevant CET
next_step: Continues within the same society to Class 11-12 via RJC CET, then optionally RDC CET for degree-level admission inside the Gurukulam system, or external entrance exams after Class 12
approx_fee: Free or heavily subsidised for eligible community students
source: teachernews.in / teachersbadi.in / jnanabhumiap.in APGPCET 2026 notification pages (verified Sept 2026)

board_authority: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt of India, implemented in AP via APTWREIS (Gurukulam) - CBSE affiliated
ownership: Government (Central Govt scheme, residential, ST students only)
classes_covered: Classes 6-12 (main entry at Class 6; Class 7/8 entry only against backlog vacancies)
exam_window: Confirmed via the 2026-27 cycle: notification released ~Jan 2026, consistent with the Jan-Mar window. Covers 28 EMRS schools across AP, 1,680 Class-6 seats (840 boys/840 girls); selection via the EMRSST (2-hour test, no negative marking, Telugu/English medium)
passing_criteria: Open only to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students, priority to PVTG students in remote areas; merit rank in the CET
next_step: Continues to Class 12 within the EMRS (CBSE board), then the same downstream entrance-exam pathways as other CBSE students
approx_fee: Free (fully funded Central Govt scheme for ST students)
source: apteachers.in / teachersbadi.in AP EMRS 2026-27 admissions notification (verified Sept 2026)

school_type: NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) - Secondary Course
board_authority: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), autonomous body under Ministry of Education, Govt of India
ownership: Government (open/distance schooling - alternative to formal day school)
classes_covered: Equivalent to Class 10 (self-paced); AP & Telangana served by NIOS Regional Centre, Hyderabad
medium_of_instruction: Learner's choice among 17+ languages including Telugu, English, Hindi, Urdu; 24 subjects offered at Secondary level
key_exam: NIOS Secondary Public Examination, or the On-Demand Examination System (ODES) after the first attempt
exam_window: Two public exams per year (April-May and October-November); ODES available roughly monthly thereafter
passing_criteria: Minimum age 14; NIOS accepts self-declaration of having 'studied enough' rather than mandating a Class 8 pass certificate
next_step: NIOS Secondary certificate is recognised at par with SSC/CBSE/ICSE Class 10 for all further admissions, including AP Intermediate, POLYCET, and ITI
approx_fee: Nominal registration + exam fees (concessions for girls, SC/ST, disabled, and BPL learners)
source: rcdelhi.nios.ac.in NIOS FAQs; nios.ac.in official site

school_type: Satellite Foundational School (GO.19 restructuring, effective AY 2025-26)
board_authority: School Education Dept, AP (Mandal/Zilla Parishad)
medium_of_instruction: Telugu / English (dual-medium in most govt schools)
key_exam: Direct enrollment at the school, no entrance test
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child of eligible pre-primary age; set up in habitations located beyond 1 km from the nearest primary school
next_step: Child moves to a Foundational or Basic/Model Primary School for Class 1 onward
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, summarized at apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child; typically co-located with an Anganwadi centre
next_step: Promotion to Basic/Model Primary or Upper Primary School for Class 3 onward
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

school_type: Basic Primary School (enrollment <60) / Model Primary School (enrollment 60+) (GO.19)
board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child aged 6+ for Class 1 as per RTE norms
next_step: Promotion to Upper Primary or High School (Standard/Comprehensive) for Class 6 onward
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child; combines primary and early-secondary in one campus
next_step: Promotion to a High School / High School Plus for Class 9-10
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP (Zilla Parishad/Municipal)
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child who has completed Class 5/8
next_step: Sits BSEAP SSC (Class 10) public exam -> proceeds to Post-10th Pathways (Phase 2)
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child; single campus spans full school stage
next_step: Sits BSEAP SSC (Class 10) public exam -> proceeds to Post-10th Pathways (Phase 2)
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child who has completed Class 5
next_step: Continues in the same campus into Intermediate (Class 11-12) after SSC, avoiding a school change
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: School Education Dept, AP
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Any child; full PP1-Intermediate campus
next_step: Continues into Intermediate (Class 11-12) on the same campus after SSC
approx_fee: Free (government school)
source: GO.19 AP school restructuring, apteacher.net/go19-re-structuring-schools-mp-zp-municipal-schools (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

school_type: RTE Act - 25% quota in private/unaided schools
board_authority: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act 2009, implemented by AP School Education Dept
classes_covered: Entry class only (typically Class 1, per state rules)
medium_of_instruction: As per the admitted private school's medium of instruction
key_exam: Online application during the state's annual RTE admission notification window; lottery/random selection among eligible applicants when seats are oversubscribed
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) / disadvantaged-group children as per AP's RTE rules; age as per entry-class norms
next_step: Student continues at the same private school on regular (non-quota) terms in subsequent classes, per RTE continuity provisions
approx_fee: Free - private school waives fees for the reserved 25% seats; school is reimbursed by government per RTE norms
source: amaravathiteacher.com/rte-admission-2025-26-andhra-pradesh-notification; education.vikaspedia.in/viewcontent/education/policies-and-schemes/right-to-education/rte-admission (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Ministry of Education, GoI - KVs present in AP mainly at central govt establishments (defence, PSU, railway townships)
key_exam: Registration during 1st-2nd week of February via local notification; draw of lots for oversubscribed general-category seats; 25% RTE reservation (10 of 40 seats/section) plus 3% horizontal reservation for disabled candidates
passing_criteria: Eligibility: Age 6 yrs as on 31 Mar of admission year for Class 1; priority order: central govt employees/ex-servicemen > autonomous body/PSU employees > state govt employees > project-sector employees > general public
next_step: Sits CBSE Class 10 board -> continues into KV Class 11-12 or elsewhere
approx_fee: Nominal fee (govt-subsidised), tuition free for girls and SC/ST students in most cases - exact current fee slab unverified
source: kvsangathan.nic.in/en/admission-guidelines (via AP Career Database - 2026-09-21 Drive snapshot, last verified 2026-09-21)

board_authority: Board of Secondary Education, Telangana (BSE Telangana / TSBSE)
ownership: Government (also followed by many private/aided schools)
exam_window: 2026: exams held March 14 - April 16, 2026 (morning shift 9:30am-12:30pm); result announced by the Board (per BSE Telangana notification, 2026 result declared in the April-June window)
passing_criteria: Minimum 35% marks required in each subject out of 100
next_step: Choose one: Intermediate (MPC/BiPC/CEC/MEC/HEC), TS POLYCET for a polytechnic diploma, ITI for a trade certificate, or NIOS if unable to continue formal school
approx_fee: Free/nominal in government schools; govt-aided schools may charge small fees - exact figures unverified, needs follow-up
source: bse.telangana.gov.in; shiksha.com/boards/bse-telangana-ssc-board (TS SSC 2026 exam schedule, pass criteria)

board_authority: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
ownership: Private (a smaller number are Central Govt schools like KVs/JNVs)
medium_of_instruction: English (most common); some Hindi/Telugu medium sections
exam_window: February-March, results typically by May
passing_criteria: Pass mark 33% per subject
next_step: Same downstream choices as SSC students: continue CBSE Class 11-12, move to Telangana Intermediate board, TS POLYCET diploma, or ITI
approx_fee: Varies widely by school - unverified, needs follow-up
source: cbseschool.org/location/telangana (568 CBSE-affiliated schools listed across Telangana's 33 districts, count varies by source - flagged); cbse.gov.in

board_authority: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
classes_covered: Classes 1-10 (ICSE is the Class 10 exam; CISCE schools also offer ISC for Class 12)
exam_window: February-March, results typically by May (per CISCE national schedule)
passing_criteria: Pass mark 33% per subject (CISCE norm)
next_step: Continue ISC (Class 11-12) at an affiliated school, move to Telangana Intermediate board, TS POLYCET diploma, or ITI
approx_fee: Varies widely by school - unverified, needs follow-up
source: cisce.org; ICSE schools are far fewer in number in Telangana than CBSE schools - exact Telangana-specific count unverified, needs follow-up

board_authority: Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), Ministry of Education, Govt of India; CBSE-affiliated
medium_of_instruction: English/Hindi (with regional language support in early classes)
key_exam: JNVST (Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test) for Class 6 entry; separate tests for lateral entry to Class 9 and 11
exam_window: 2026: Class 6 Phase 1 exam held Dec 13, 2025 (results Mar 17, 2026); Phase 2 exam held April 11, 2026
passing_criteria: Merit-based selection via JNVST; no board pass/fail at entry
next_step: Continues to Class 11-12 within the JNV system, or Intermediate/other pathway if not continuing
approx_fee: Free tuition (Central Govt funded); nominal Vidyalaya Vikas Nidhi fee for some classes/categories
source: navodaya.gov.in; school.careers360.com/articles/navodaya-vidyalaya-merit-list-2026 (JNVST 2026 schedule); telanganatoday.com (7 new JNVs approved Dec 2024 for Jagtial, Nizamabad, Bhadradri Kothagudem, Medchal-Malkajgiri, Mahbubnagar, Sangareddy, Suryapet districts, but NVS had not opened Class VI admissions at these 7 for AY2026-27 as of the report)

school_type: Sainik School - none located in Telangana
board_authority: Sainik Schools Society, Ministry of Defence (where applicable nationally)
key_exam: AISSEE (All India Sainik Schools Entrance Examination), conducted by NTA - Telangana students can sit the exam at AISSEE centers in Hyderabad and Karimnagar and gain admission to Sainik Schools in other states
exam_window: 2026: application closed Nov 9, 2025; exam held Jan 18, 2026
passing_criteria: Not applicable - no Sainik School physically located within Telangana
next_step: Telangana students seeking Sainik School education must apply via AISSEE for admission to a school in another state (e.g. nearby Sainik School Korukonda in Andhra Pradesh, or any other Sainik School nationally)
approx_fee: Not applicable in-state
source: ezyschooling.com/sainik-schools-in-telangana (confirms no Sainik School located in Telangana, along with Meghalaya, Sikkim, Tripura); exams.nta.nic.in/sainik-school-society (AISSEE 2026 exam centers list)

school_type: Telangana Gurukulam Residential Schools (TSWREIS / TTWREIS / MJPTBCWREIS / TREIS)
board_authority: State welfare societies: Telangana Social Welfare REIS (TSWREIS, SC), Telangana Tribal Welfare REIS (TTWREIS, ST), Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Telangana BC Welfare REIS (MJPTBCWREIS, BC), and Telangana Residential Educational Institutions Society (TREIS, general/meritorious)
classes_covered: Predominantly Class 5 entry through Intermediate (Class 5-12); backlog entrance tests also exist for Classes 6-9
key_exam: TGCET (Telangana Gurukulam Common Entrance Test) for Class 5 entry across TSWREIS/TTWREIS/MJPTBCWREIS/TREIS; separate CETs for 6th-9th backlog seats (e.g. TSG BLV CET) and RJC CET for Intermediate 1st year entry
exam_window: TGCET typically conducted in the April-May window annually; 2026 notification issued by TG Gurukulam societies (exact 2026 date varies by society - unverified precise date, needs follow-up)
passing_criteria: Merit-based selection via entrance test, subject to caste/income eligibility criteria (e.g. TSWREIS Intermediate: family income capped at Rs 2,00,000/year via MeeSeva certificate)
next_step: Continue at Gurukulam Junior College (Intermediate) via RJC CET, or transition to general Intermediate/other post-10th pathway
approx_fee: Free (fully residential, food/lodging/uniform covered by the state welfare society)
source: tgcet.cgg.gov.in; tgswreis.telangana.gov.in; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telangana_Social_Welfare_Residential_Educational_Institutions_Society (268 TSWREIS institutions, ~150,000 students); mjptbcwreis.in (281 MJPTBCWREIS residential schools & junior colleges); teachersbadi.in (TGCET/TGTWREIS 2026 admission notifications)

board_authority: National Education Society for Tribal Students (NESTS), Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Govt of India; implemented locally by Telangana State Eklavya Model Residential Schools Society (TSES)
ownership: Central Government (Tribal Affairs) with state-level implementing society
key_exam: EMRS CET for Class 6 entry (and backlog seats for Classes 7-9)
exam_window: Annual CET notification issued by TSES; 2026 notification released for 6th/7th/8th/9th class admissions (exact 2026 exam date not confirmed from official source - needs follow-up)
passing_criteria: Merit-based selection via CET; open to ST students primarily (per national EMRS scheme eligibility)
next_step: Continues through to Class 12 within the EMRS system
approx_fee: Free (fully residential, Central Govt funded)
source: tsemrs.telangana.gov.in (23 EMRS schools functioning in Telangana under TSES); nests.tribal.gov.in; testbook.com/emrs-recruitment/emrs-school-list-in-telangana

school_type: NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling) - Secondary Course
board_authority: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS), autonomous body under Ministry of Education, GoI; Regional Centre Hyderabad covers Telangana
key_exam: NIOS Public Examination (on-demand and fixed cycles, typically October-November and April-May)
exam_window: Rolling admission; 2026 admission cycle leads to October-November 2026 public exam
passing_criteria: Pass mark 33% per subject (NIOS norm, same as CBSE-aligned open schooling standard)
next_step: NIOS Senior Secondary Course (Class 12 equivalent), or Intermediate/POLYCET/ITI if age/eligibility permits
approx_fee: Nominal registration + exam fees, lower than formal private schooling - exact current fee slab unverified, needs follow-up
source: rchyderabad.nios.ac.in (Regional Centre Hyderabad; 24 affiliated study centres across Telangana districts including Hyderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar, Adilabad, Nalgonda, Mahbubnagar, Medak, Ramagundam); nios.ac.in/admission.aspx

board_authority: Telangana Model School Society (TGMS), Government of Telangana (originated under the central RMSA scheme)
key_exam: MSAT / TGMS CET (Model School Admission Test / Common Entrance Test) for Class 6 entry, with backlog entrance tests for Classes 7-10
exam_window: 2026 (Class 6): online applications Jan 28 - Feb 28, 2026; hall tickets from Apr 9, 2026; exam held Apr 19, 2026 (10am-12noon)
passing_criteria: Merit-based selection via MCQ entrance test in English, Mathematics and Science; age criteria apply (e.g. Class 6 2026: SC/ST born 01.09.2011-31.08.2015, OC/BC/BC-C born 01.09.2013-31.08.2015)
next_step: Continue to Class 10 at the same Model School, then Intermediate/POLYCET/ITI as with other Class 10 students
approx_fee: Application fee Rs 200 (general/OC) or Rs 125 (BC/SC/ST/PWD/EWS); tuition largely free/nominal for a govt school - exact tuition fee unverified, needs follow-up
source: news.careers360.com (MSAT 2026 schedule); education.sakshi.com (TG Model Schools Admission Test 2026 notification); tgms.telangana.gov.in

board_authority: Samagra Shiksha (Govt of India centrally-sponsored scheme), implemented by the Telangana school education department
classes_covered: Classes 6-10 (some upgraded KGBVs extend to Intermediate, Classes 11-12)

board_authority: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), Ministry of Education, Govt of India; CBSE-affiliated

passing_criteria: CBSE norm (33% per subject) at board-exam classes
next_step: Continue through to Class 12 within the KV system, or transition to Intermediate/other board

source: rohyderabad.kvs.gov.in (KVS Regional Office Hyderabad administers KVs across both Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, 85 KVs total in the region); newsonair.gov.in (Telangana state to reach 39 KVs after 4 new ones sanctioned, as of Oct 2025)
